purpose: Independent simulated beginner mouse-only usability report using the fixed question set.
persona: Simulated first-time RILL user interested in a short ambient soundtrack sketch.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Visible MIDI hint, Pencil drags, Duplicate instructions, mixer labels and the on-screen naming keyboard enabled all requested editing and file operations. Exact trimming and shifting controls needed correction.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark interface, turquoise waveform and note clips, and large mixer strips looked coherent and readable.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Most editing actions responded promptly. WAV export visibly took several seconds and playback repeatedly stopped with an output-stream error, interrupting the task. This is not a benchmark.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Most actions had clear labels. Pan drag direction needed adjustment, precise clip-end snapping was fiddly, and the error banner moved mixer controls underneath subsequent intended clicks.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: Found audio and MIDI editing, VST assignment, volume, pan, mute, solo, bus, send, mouse-only naming, save and both exports. Reliable playback was not established in this session.

findings.observation: Double-clicking the visible MIDI hint opened Device library; Assign instrument created a track with Rill Lab Sine. Pencil drags visibly created sustained notes and extended the clip.
Duplicate showed an explicit click instruction. Repeated clips plus a trimmed final audio segment produced a project duration readout of 0:30.000.
First trim ended at 30.134 seconds. A small further edge drag corrected arrangement duration to 30.000, while the loop range still read 30.134. Exact endpoints were difficult at the zoomed-out scale.
Mixer fader and pan drags updated numerical values. Add bus created a bus strip, and MIDI Add send > + Send > New bus produced a visible 0.25x Post send.
Playback initially advanced the transport and lit meters, then stopped with 'Audio output stream failed or disconnected'. Retry briefly restarted playback before the same failure appeared again.

The output error banner shortened the mixer strips and shifted pan and mute/solo controls upward; subsequent clicks at the old locations did not toggle the intended buttons. After dismissing the banner, toggling MIDI Solo visibly worked.
Rename project included a visible Keyboard button. Clicking its letters set the title to mist without physical keyboard input. Save proposed mist.rill and the unsaved dot disappeared after OK.
WAV export displayed Arrangement 0:30; effect tails were unchecked. MIDI showed an Exported notice. Recent exports listed mist.wav and mist.mid under Completed exports.

outcome.status: Completed through the visible UI: saved a named project and completed WAV and MIDI exports. Playback was only briefly observed and repeatedly failed; exported contents await independent verification.
outcome.composition: Four copies of the supplied Circuit rhythm audio, with the final copy trimmed; seven repeats of a two-bar MIDI pattern containing two sustained three-note groups. First group visibly C4/G4/C5. Lowered audio and MIDI levels, panned audio L16 and MIDI R28, and added a MIDI send to New bus. Ambient sketch intent; audible result not assessed.
outcome.playback_observed: Play changed to Pause, transport advanced and audio/MIDI/master meters lit. Output stream failure then stopped playback. Retry briefly restarted, followed by another failure. No heard-audio claim.

limitations: No file contents or heard audio claim; independent coordinator verification follows.
WAV appeared under Completed exports, but a separate transient WAV success banner was not captured because MIDI export followed while WAV export was in progress.
Loop endpoint remained 30.134 seconds; project duration and WAV arrangement export dialog showed 30 seconds.
Playback failures occurred under the laboratory virtual audio backend; no claim about physical hardware latency or third-party VST compatibility.
Elapsed session includes screenshot and tool overhead.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged Circuit drums from -6.0 to -10.8 dB and New instrument from -2.5 to -4.6 dB; both numerical readouts visibly changed.
mixer_outcome.pan: Diagonal knob drags initially produced audio R7 and MIDI R28. A horizontal left drag then set audio L16; MIDI remained R28. Final arrangement displays those values.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute; button highlighted amber and audio level meter went dark while the MIDI meter remained active after Retry. Later turned it off after dismissing the error banner; final Mute buttons were unhighlighted.
mixer_outcome.solo: After correcting for controls shifting with the error banner, clicked MIDI Solo and observed green highlight. Clicked again to disable; final Solo buttons were unhighlighted. Audible isolation not assessed.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus in Mixer; a New bus strip appeared at 0.0 dB routed to Master.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI track Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a send to New bus at 0.25x with Post selected. No effect inserted and audible send result not assessed.
